digest.component_or_area: grounding analyzer test suite and external tool integration
propositions: External analyzer and grounding tests consume 234–251 worker-seconds on macOS, with multiple modules invoking real OpenGrep, ast-grep, gitleaks, and metric scans redundantly.

Immutable fixture trees and identical scan payloads across 12 test nodes offer measurable reuse opportunities: five Python-oracle scans, five mixed-coverage scans, and three identical JS scans combined project 57.7 seconds (68.4%) reduction when consolidated.
Call-local YAML source-path deduplication in _run_opengrep removes 11.89 seconds (5.9s per pair of scans) by validating each Semgrep YAML source once instead of once per detector.

Real analyzer presence, timeout behavior, invalid-detector quarantine, evidence normalization, and failure-mode detection must remain explicitly tested and contractually guarded to support CI fail-close integration.

pytest-xdist worker-local fixture scope under `-n 3 --dist worksteal` cannot automatically share session-scoped results across processes; implementing full cohort reuse requires either test-boundary consolidation, cross-process immutable artifact caching, or distribution changes and operator approval.

New defects discovered: grounding metric detector omits `--by-file` flag so scc never emits file matches; MCP grounding_info schema test emits unresolved lifespan warning; enrich drain gate check repeatedly exceeds 20ms budget.
